data.title: Monza vs Cagliari prediction, preview & betting tips – 19/10/2026
data.content:
They have one of the worst defensive records in the league, having already conceded 15 goals, although Monza have found the net in each of their last six matches, scoring nine times during that run.

For the home side, Lorenzo Lucchesi is suspended after receiving a red card against Lazio, while Matteo Pessina and Jan Ziolkowski are both sidelined with injuries.

Cagliari have surprised many with an impressive start to the season, having lost only to Inter Milan in Serie A so far. [...] They bounced back from a 2-1 defeat to Verona in the Coppa Italia by securing three consecutive victories.

Fabio Pisacane's side have won all their away matches in the league this season and head into this fixture on the back of a 1-1 draw with Juventus.

Cagliari boast the joint-best defensive record in the league alongside AS Roma, having conceded just three goals, and secured a 3-0 victory over Monza in their last meeting.
